# Data Source Analysis

The U.S. Energy Information Administration API v2 requires authentication and will not serve data to unauthenticated callers. The source explicitly rejects requests without an API key, returning HTTP 403 with an error message directing registration. To use this source, an operator must register for a free API key at the URL provided in the error response, then store that key in the credential vault for use by a dedicated connector—never as a template parameter or command-line argument. For the operator directive to retrieve monthly U.S. retail electricity sales data, this source is worth the registration step: EIA data is authoritative and the registration process is straightforward.
